_about.source: Read directly out of docProps/core.xml and docProps/app.xml with zipfile, and out of the PDFs with pdfinfo. Not produced by the extraction code in src/, so it can be used to check that code.
_about.generated_samples: samples/generated/ is not listed here. Its known values are the constants at the top of tests/make_generated_samples.py.
_about.pdf_dates: PDF creation/modification dates are stamped at export time and are not fixed values, so they are not recorded as expected values.

notes: The only sample with a hyperlink base set.
lastPrinted (10:17) is earlier than created (10:18). The file was re-created after being printed, which resets created and the revision counter but keeps lastPrinted.

sample_msft.pdf.source: sample.docx, saved from Word as "Best for electronic distribution and accessibility"
notes: Word's own exporter carries title, subject, keywords and author across.
Company, Manager, Category, revision and lastModifiedBy do not survive; they have no equivalent in PDF.

sample_printing.pdf.source: sample.docx, saved from Word as "Best for printing"
notes: This route goes through the macOS print pipeline, which rebuilds the file and drops every document property. Only the timestamps and the producer string remain.
The producer string identifies the operating system and build number of the machine that made the file.
